test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

(A) This fridge / (B) comes including / (C) a 5-year / (D) warranty.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"including"** means containing something as a part of the whole. (शामिल करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The package is including all necessary accessories.
 
 
 
• The correct word should be **"with"**, which means accompanied by something or someone. (के साथ)
 
 
• **Example: **This fridge** comes with** a 5-year warranty.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is "This fridge comes with a 5-year warranty."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option A: This fridge **(यह फ्रिज): No error.

 
 
• **Example:** This fridge is very efficient.
 
 
 
• **Option C: a 5-year **(5 साल का): No error.
 
 
• **Example: **The product comes with a 5-year guarantee.
 
 
 
• **Option D: warranty **(गारंटी): No error.
 
 
• **Example:** The warranty covers all manufacturing defects.
